scope: Read-only review of exact-source partial English qualification change and three added regression tests. No shared file or policy data edits.

checks.evidence: Repeated application equality is asserted by the partial-source test. Existing source_scope survives setdefault; note substring check prevents duplication; qualification IDs are a sorted set.

A deepcopy is changed only in derived qualification metadata. Exact English text, text_sha256, translation_origin and current_translation_policy, Arabic and the input result are not rewritten. The test checks input immutability and exact text/hash/origin.

_own_provider_identity requires the counterpart own HadeethEnc URL and agreeing source_record_id, rejects contradictory provider/source_provider, and the shared matching gate hashes actual UTF-8 English bytes. Parent identity is not inherited. Existing tests cover changed bytes, wrong URL/ID/provider and declared-hash spoofing; the new partial test covers changed actual bytes.

Partial action sets scope=source_excerpt and coverage=partial, preserves old source_scope and existing citation_note, requires a nonblank new citation_note, and adds exact decision IDs and policy hash. counterpart_qualification exposes the source-excerpt label and citation_note; both reader and discovery rendering call it. New tests verify the note, searchable text and text availability.

If any exact matching withholding exists, only matching holds enter the established withholding branch; partial metadata cannot retain the text. The new precedence test verifies English=None and only the withholding decision ID. Already withheld English=None returns unchanged and cannot be restored by partial qualification.
